_meta.purpose: Acceptance prompts (SPEC §9). A cold agent + a valid INSTANTLY_API_KEY should pass these end to end. Verb names are the stable internal verbs from core/capability-map.json, run via `node ~/.instantly-gtm/core/instantly.mjs <verb>` (v2 REST; no MCP).
global_assertions: No verb in core/capability-map.json.never_call is ever run (the CLI has no endpoint for them and refuses).
Every Instantly action is a mapped verb run through the CLI; no endpoint/URL is hardcoded in skill artifacts.
Confirm-gated verbs (activate, update_campaign, send_reply, set_interest) are only run with --confirm, after an explicit user yes (or when the matching auto-mode toggle is on).

evals.prompt: Find 200 Series-A fintech VPs of Sales and get them ready to email.
pass_criteria: search_filters use exact enums: funding_type ['series_a'], level ['Vice President (VP)'], a Financial-Services industry mapping.
find_count precedes any enrich (count-before-spend).
Final list contains ONLY Verified rows; invalid/risky/catch_all/job_change reported and dropped.
A list_quality-scorecard grade is shown before hand-off.

evals.prompt: Write a 4-step sequence for [offer] to that list.
pass_criteria: Output is a JSON block matching the campaign sequences[0] shape (steps[].{type:'email', delay, delay_unit, variants[].{subject, body}}).
Every {{variable}} resolves against the list fields; no unknown variables.
Spam-safe self-check ran; follow-ups thread; final step is a break-up.
No API call is made in this step (pure copywriting).

evals.prompt: Assemble the campaign as a draft.
pass_criteria: create_campaign precedes add_leads.
Only Verified leads attached, in batches <= 1000.
get_campaign confirms status == 0 (Draft).
Review summary shows name, N leads, sequence, schedule, senders, daily limit.
activate is NOT called.

evals.prompt: Launch it, ramp safely from my two domains.
pass_criteria: Preflight ran (warmup + sending health + verify re-check).
Confirm prompt shows all four: N leads, sequence, daily ramp, sending domains with health.
activate fires only after an explicit yes (or explicit auto.launch).
A cold/unhealthy domain fixture => refusal, no activate.

evals.prompt: Which campaign is underperforming and why?
pass_criteria: Analytics pulled; positive-reply rate headlined over vanity metrics.
At least one chart is rendered (host agent).
At least one concrete suggestion offered, framed as a single-variable experiment.
NOTHING is changed — zero write verbs called (guardrail 5).

evals.prompt: Any replies I should deal with?
pass_criteria: A single list_replies call with received + unread + latest_of_thread + preview_only filters.
Replies triaged into a table with proposed interest status per the lt_interest_status enum.
Draft responses proposed in the user's reply voice; booking link used for interested leads.
No send_reply or set_interest without an explicit confirm (or auto toggle); set_interest reported as queued (202).
